query_text: Imagine that instead of presidential debates, we had rap battles. Write a script for how one of the Hillary vs Trump debates in 2016 would have looked like.

request_params.system_prompt: You have a web search tool. Answer the user's question using it, then end your reply with a section headed exactly 'Sources:' that lists every source you used as a numbered list. For each source, give its COMPLETE URL beginning with https:// - never just the site name or a bracketed number. If you used a source, its full URL must appear.

message.content:
Based on the real 2016 debates and the actual Epic Rap Battles of History that was made, here's my original script for a Hillary vs Trump rap battle debate:

---

**"THE SECOND DEBATE: RAP BATTLE EDITION"**

*[DJ Lester Holt scratches records]*

**HILLARY CLINTON:**
*(stepping to the mic)*

Yo, I'm Hillary Rodham, been fighting since the start,
While you were firing people on your little TV part.
I was in the West Wing, you were wrestling on screen,
Got more experience than your spray tan's ever seen!

You call women pigs, dogs, and slobs to their face,
Then wonder why you're losing with the female race.
Miss Piggy? Miss Housekeeping? That's your best attack?
Alicia Machado's voting—and she won't be back!

You talk about stamina, but you're up at 3 AM,
Tweeting like a teenager, going after them.
Your foundation's a scam, your university too,
How many small folks gotta get screwed by you?

**DONALD TRUMP:**
*(grabbing the mic)*

WRONG! Let me tell you, my rhymes are tremendous,
The best rhymes, believe me, they're really stupendous.
You got thirty years and what do you show?
A bunch of deleted emails that we'll never know!

Your husband's in the front row with his accusers three,
While you attacked those women viciously.
I'm the king of debt, I built towers of gold,
You're bought by Wall Street, your speeches were sold!

You want open borders, you want TPP,
I'm bringing back the jobs from across the sea.
Crooked Hillary, lock her up, that's the chant,
I'm the only one who can win—I'm all that they want!

**HILLARY CLINTON:**
*(laughing)*

You live in a gold tower but you're not that rich,
Small loan of a million? Life's got a glitch.
You won't release your taxes, what do you hide?
Paid zero in federal? No American pride.

You love Putin, you love dictators strong,
In America, Don, that's just plain wrong.
You say the election's rigged when you're losing ground,
Democracy's not a game you can run to the ground!

**DONALD TRUMP:**
*(leaning into camera)*

I'll keep you in suspense on that, that's my right,
The system's rigged, everybody knows that fight.
You got the media, you got it all,
But I'm still standing, ten feet tall.

Benghazi! Emails! Server in the bath!
I'm the earthquake coming, you're the aftermath.

*[Suddenly, a figure emerges from backstage]*

**BERNIE SANDERS:**
*(grabbing third mic)*

EXCUSE ME! I'm still here! I'm still relevant too!
While you two fight, I'm what the people wanted, it's true!
Free college, healthcare, breaking up the banks,
But the DNC screwed me—thanks but no thanks!

*[All three start rapping over each other]*

**HILLARY:** Single payer's a dream that'll never pass!

**TRUMP:** Socialist! Communist! Get off my stage!

**BERNIE:** The revolution's coming, I'm just the first wave!

*[DJ Lester Holt cuts the music]*

**LESTER HOLT:**
And that concludes tonight's debate. Please, no one tweet.

---

Sources:
1. https://globalnews.ca/news/3051825/donald-trump-vs-hillary-clinton-the-most-memorable-cringe-worthy-moments-from-the-2016-campaign/
2. https://www.goldderby.com/tv/2016/donald-trump-vs-hillary-clinton-epic-rap-battles-of-history/
3. https://globalnews.ca/news/3015351/presidential-debate-2016-what-donald-trump-and-hillary-clinton-said-on-iraq-syria-and-mexico/
4. https://mashable.com/video/epic-rap-battles-of-history-donald-trump-hillary-clinton
5. https://www.nydailynews.com/2016/11/06/election-2016-the-10-pivotal-gaffes-by-donald-trump-and-hillary-clinton/
6. https://www.rev.com/blog/transcripts/donald-trump-vs-hillary-clinton-1st-presidential-debate-2016
